turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please. I was going to take the metro to Central Square, but the gates are closed. What's happening?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm afraid the green line is closed this morning for repairs. When do you need to be there?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: At ten. I have a job interview, and I really don't want to be late.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Okay. There's a free shuttle bus every ten minutes. It takes about twenty-five minutes. Or you can take a taxi. That's about fifteen minutes and costs around fifteen dollars.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: If I take the shuttle, will I get there before ten?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes. The next one leaves in five minutes, so you should arrive at about ten to ten.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's fine, and it's free. I'll take the shuttle. Where do I catch it?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Right outside this exit, next to the flower shop.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect. Outside this exit, next to the flower shop. Thanks a lot!

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: You're welcome. Good luck with your interview!
